svg.title: Legal Practice Platform, Multi-tenant law-firm SaaS
svg.desc: Legal Practice Platform. Multi-tenant law-firm SaaS. Intake, matters, documents, invoicing, payroll. Firm isolation, RBAC/RLS, ethical walls, MFA. Permission-aware AI document analysis. Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL. Open the live demo.
